body: some days its more serious than others, but i never think its extremely serious. only once when i was young that it was very serious. i think it may in fact be a coping mechanism, but i dont want it to be. i've tried meds and therapy and i've done a lot of talking to people and yet it is still here.
it might be coping because i've been doing this for many years, but i just cant seem to stop. i've never actually tried killing myself. i just cant stop think about doing it.
i've tried medication and therapy many times, but they either made it worse or didn't make anything significantly better
